subject: Service provider roster change — impact assessment request
messages:
From: Julia Kaplan <julia.kaplan@skyfin.com>
To: logan.wright@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@skyfin.com
Date: Tue, 18 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Service provider roster change — impact assessment request

Hi Logan,

Hope youre well. We received an automated notice that Redwood added a new service provider, EdgeOps LLC, to your processing roster and that some processing for eu-west-1 may be routed to them. Before we mark this change as acknowledged on our side, can you please provide the following: 

- A current service-provider inventory (per-processor CSV listing the name, purpose, data categories, and country/region(s) where data is processed).
- A dataflow diagram showing where inference logs and telemetry are stored and which vendors have access.
- DPA/Annex A impact: whether EdgeOps will be added as a Subprocessor under the existing DPA, and any proposed Annex language.
- Confirmation whether EdgeOps will have access to raw prompts or only aggregated/metrics data.
- Evidence of compliance: SOC 2 Type II report or equivalent, KMS/HSM details if they hold keys or encrypted telemetry.
- Effective date for the change and contact at EdgeOps for a security review.

We need this information for our internal data protection review; if EdgeOps will process EU personal data outside the EEA we will require clarity on transfer mechanism(s). Can you send the inventory and the diagram by EOD Wednesday (Jun 20)? If you have a vendor notice or any attachments, please include them.

Thanks — Julia
Julia Kaplan
Senior Compliance Manager, SkyFin
julia.kaplan@skyfin.com

Attachment: edgeops_notice_20280617.eml (received from vendor)
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Julia Kaplan <julia.kaplan@skyfin.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 18 Jun 2028 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Service provider roster change — impact assessment request

Hi Julia,

Thanks for the heads-up and the clear checklist. We received the same vendor notification yesterday and Ive pulled together the initial materials and an internal action plan. High level:

- EdgeOps LLC (EO-374) is being added to our telemetry pipeline to provide hosted log aggregation and short-term retention for inference metrics only. They will not be in the request/response path for live inference; they will receive telemetry streams derived from inference (latency, error rates, aggregated counters).
- We do not expect EdgeOps to process raw user prompts or model outputs. Ill confirm scope below with their security contact.

Ive attached the inventory and a simplified dataflow diagram for your review (see attachments). Action items on our side:
- Marissa will scope any necessary DPA/Annex updates and circulate proposed language.
- Rishi will run a quick security checklist and request SOC2 evidence from EdgeOps.
- I will confirm the effective date (targeting 2028-06-25) and share contact details for EdgeOps security lead.

Attachments: redwood_service_provider_inventory_20280618.csv; dataflow_edgeops_eu.pdf

If anything in the inventory looks incomplete, flag it and well expand. We can also set up a joint call with EdgeOps if SkyFin wants to run a vendor security interview.

Regards,
Logan Wright
Head of Platform Operations
Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Julia Kaplan <julia.kaplan@skyfin.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 18 Jun 2028 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Service provider roster change — impact assessment request

On Tue, Jun 18, 2028 at 09:12 AM Julia Kaplan <julia.kaplan@skyfin.com> wrote:
> Hi Logan,
> 
> Hope youre well. We received an automated notice that Redwood added a new service provider, EdgeOps LLC...

Thanks for the quick response, Logan. A couple of clarifications and legal points from our side:

1) Access scope: Please confirm explicitly whether EdgeOps will ever be able to reconstruct user-level sequences (full prompts + responses). If the answer is yes even for debug snapshots, we need to treat them as a processor with access to personal data and update the DPA Annex immediately.

2) DPA update approach: We typically add new subprocessors by providing the customer an updated Annex A and 14-day review period unless the subprocessor is in scope of an existing approved vendor list. Ill prepare suggested Annex language to add EdgeOps (include EO-374 identifier) and mark the effective date as the earliest date they will receive telemetry. I will also include a clause requiring SOC 2 Type II or equivalent within 30 days of onboarding.

3) Cross-border transfers: If any telemetry will be replicated or accessible outside the EEA, confirm the transfer mechanism (SCCs, adequacy, or other). We will need specific contractual language in that case.

Ill attach a draft Annex to the DocuSign link below for your review by EOD. Logan, can you confirm whether EdgeOps will be limited to aggregated metrics by close of business today so we can avoid an urgent amendment for raw-data access?

DocuSign (draft Annex): https://redwood.app/docusign/ABC-123-edgeops

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Julia Kaplan <julia.kaplan@skyfin.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Service provider roster change — impact assessment request

Thanks Logan and Marissa — this is helpful. Two quick asks:

- Please upload the SOC 2 Type II (or equivalent) for EdgeOps when available. Well accept a provisional audit report with a follow-up commitment if the report is dated within the last 12 months.
- Confirm whether any telemetry or backups will be accessible from outside the EU/EEA. If so, please list the countries and the transfer safeguard(s).

If you can provide both by EOD Wednesday (Jun 20) that will keep our review on schedule. If not, please propose the earliest possible delivery date.

Best,
Julia
Senior Compliance Manager, SkyFin
